name: Zai-jan
source:
He is the head of the Raksasa Party, a Chinese underworld organization.
He is helping Chinese government officials to invest their assets in tax havens and is receiving various favors from them.
He then plans to team up with The Web to assassinate the heads of Hong Kong's underworld organizations in order to advance into Hong Kong.
